review_candidates.title: Enterprise Agentic AI - Solution Lead
review_candidates.description_excerpt: SDG Group is a global enterprise data, analytics and AI consultancy. We design and build data and AI solutions for our clients. We are building a production Agentic AI platform as part of a large-scale enterprise AI transformation, and we are looking for a Solution Lead to own the end-to-end technical design and act as the design authority across the build. What you will do Own the solution design across three layers: the agent orchestration layer, the governed data products, and the LLM routing
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: What you bring 10+ years in enterprise data and AI or solution architecture, with recent hands-on work on LLM and agentic systems. Hands-on experience with LangGraph (or a comparable agent-orchestration framework), RAG, and model-routing patterns, enough to set the design and review the build, not only to advise on it.
